πολυπίδακος: πολυπίδαξ — many-springed, rich in springs; fem. gen. sg., epithet of Ida
ποσσὶ: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic ποσσί (= Attic ποσί)
πριαμίδην: Πριαμίδης — son of Priam; masc. acc. sg., patronymic

ἀχνύμενος: ἄχνυμαι — grieve, be vexed, be distressed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.

ἃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. pl.: ’which’
ἄλλ: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. acc. pl., elided (ἄλλ’ = ἄλλα): ’others’
ἄλλως: ἄλλως — otherwise, in another way; adv.
ἄμμι: ἐγώ — I; epic dat. pl. ἄμμι (= Attic ἡμῖν): ’to us’
ἄμφεπον: ἀμφέπω — busy oneself about, tend; impf. 3 pl. act. (the form also serves 1 sg.), unaugmented: ’were busy about’
ἄνακτι: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. dat. sg.
ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
ἄνωχθι: ἄνωγα — bid, command; perf. imper. 2 sg. with present sense: ’bid! order!’
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄσπετον: ἄσπετος — unspeakable, vast beyond telling (ἀ- + root of ’say’); adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with κῦδος: ’boundless’ · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’beyond measure, boundlessly’
ἄϊδος: Ἅιδης (Ἄϊς) — Hades; masc. gen. sg., epic Ἄϊδος (Attic Ἅιδου)
ἅμα: ἅμα — together, at the same time; adv. · also prep. + dat.: ’together with’
ἅπαντα: ἅπας — all, the whole of; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with μιν: ’the whole of it’ · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with a noun: ’all (the sorrows)’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with τά: ’all (these things)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν: ’all (the army)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with κρημνόν: ’the whole (bank)’
ἆσαι: ἄω — glut, satiate (+ gen.); aor. inf. act. ἆσαι: ’to glut’
ἐΐσας: ἐΐσος (ἔΐσος) — equal, even, balanced (of ships, sense uncertain); fem. acc. pl., epic · also of mares, ’balanced, level’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ἐΐσας ’balanced along the back’)
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’) · also in παρ’ ἐκ (= παρέκ) + acc.: ’beyond’ (παρ’ ἐκ νόον ’beyond reason’)
ἐκάλυψε: καλύπτω — cover, veil, enshroud; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented
ἐλαίῳ: ἔλαιον — olive oil; neut. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with oil’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνόησε: νοέω — perceive, notice, think; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’noticed’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’) · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (left) side’ (ἐπ’ ἀριστερόφιν ’on the left’) · also + gen., ’on’ (ἐπ’ εὐνάων ’on anchor-stones’)
ἐπέτελλεν: ἐπιτέλλω — command, charge, enjoin; impf. 3 sg. act. (augment inside the compound), + dat. + inf.: ’charged’
ἐπειγόμενοι: ἐπείγομαι — press on, be hard pressed, hasten; pres. part. mid./pass. masc. nom. pl.: ’hard pressed’
ἐπισχερώ: ἐπισχερώ — in a row, one after another, in succession; adv. (from σχερός ’continuous line’)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’) · also + dat. of respect: ’in’ (ἐπὶ φρεσὶ … κέκασται ’excels in wits’) · also + gen., of range: ’as far as’ (ὅσον ἐπὶ δουρὸς ἐρωή ’as far as a spear’s rush carries’)
ἐριαύχενας: ἐριαύχην — strong-necked (ἐρι- intensive, exact sense not known); masc. acc. pl., with ἵππους
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’) · also + acc. of time: ’until’ (ἐς ἠέλιον καταδύντα ’until sunset’) · also + acc. of purpose: ’for’ (ἐς βρωτύν ’for food’)
ἐσθλοὺς: ἐσθλός — good, brave; masc. acc. pl.
ἐσθλὸς: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. nom. sg.: ’good’
ἐσσυμένως: ἐσσυμένως — hastily, eagerly; adv. from the participle of σεύομαι ’rush’
ἐτέλεσσας: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish, fulfil; aor. 2 sg., epic -σσ-: ’you fulfilled’
ἐτίθει: τίθημι — put, place; impf. 3 sg.; in tmesis with ἐν (ἐν … ἐτίθει = ἐνετίθει): ’put in’
ἐφεστήκει: ἐφίστημι — set upon; intrans. perf. and plpf. stand upon; plpf. 3 sg. (= Attic ἐφειστήκει) + dat.: ’was standing on’
ἑκατόμβην: ἑκατόμβη — hecatomb, great sacrifice (originally of a hundred oxen); fem. acc. sg.
ἑλὼν: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken’
ἑτάροιο: ἕταρος — comrade, companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), gen. of cause after a verb of anger · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of cause after ἄχος: ’for the comrade’ (ἄχος … ἑτάροιο ’grief for the comrade’)
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’companions!’ (ἐρίηρες ἑταῖροι ’trusty companions’)
ἑταῖρον: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. sg.
ἔβαν: βαίνω — go; aor. 3 pl., epic ἔβαν (= Attic ἔβησαν)
ἔδυ: δύω — go in, sink down; aor. 3 sg. (root aorist ἔδυ): ’went down into’
ἔειπεν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., epic augmented (ἔ-ειπεν, = Attic εἶπεν)
ἔλαβε: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., with a gen. of the part seized: ’took hold of’
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἔνθ’ ἄρα τε φρένες ἔρχαται ’where the midriff is shut’)
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
ἔνι: ἐν — in; prep. + dat., postpositive with accent thrown back after its noun (νέεσσ’ ἔνι = Attic ἐν ναυσί) · also ἔνι = ἔνεστι, ἔνεισι, accented on the first syllable: ’is in, are in’ (οὔ οἱ ἔνι φρένες ’there are no wits in him’)
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also ’tilled land, farmland’ (ἔργα νέμοντο ’inhabited the farmlands’)
ἔστι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., accented ἔστι at clause start: existential, ’there is’ · also impersonal + inf.: ’it is possible’ (οὐδέ πῃ ἔστι … εὐχετάασθαι)
ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’hold, keep’ · also impf. 3 sg., ’had as wife, was married to’ (θυγατέρα ἔχε ’had the daughter to wife’)
ἔχοντες: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
ἕκαστ: ἕκαστος — each, every; neut. acc. pl., elided (ἕκαστ’ = ἕκαστα): ’each thing’
ἕκαστον: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. acc. sg.: ’each (man)’
ἕκτορα: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
ἕλικας: ἕλιξ — twisted, curved (of cattle’s horns); masc./fem. acc. pl. · also ἕλιξ as a noun — spiral, coil (an ornament); masc. acc. pl.
ἕταρον: ἑταῖρος (epic ἕταρος) — companion, comrade; masc. acc. sg.
ἠΰτε: ἠΰτε — like as, even as; epic particle introducing a comparison
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠελίοιο: ἥλιος — sun; masc. gen. sg., epic ἠελίοιο (= Attic ἡλίου)
ἠρᾶθ: ἀράομαι — pray; impf. 3 sg., elided and aspirated (ἠρᾶθ’ = ἠρᾶτο)
ἠὼς: Ἠώς — Dawn, the goddess; fem. nom. sg. · also ἠώς — morning, dawn (the time of day, not the goddess); fem. nom. sg.: ’it was morning’ (ἠὼς ἦν)
ἡμιόνων: ἡμίονος — mule; gen. pl., construed as fem. with ἀγροτεράων
ἤγαγε: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’brought’
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤματα: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’all the days, every day’
ἥρωϊ: ἥρως — hero, warrior; masc. dat. sg., epic -ϊ (= Attic ἥρῳ)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦλθον: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 1 sg. (the same ending serves 3 pl.): ’I came’
ἧκε: ἵημι — send, let go, let fall; aor. 3 sg. (with πρό in tmesis: ’sent forth’) · also with ἐξ in tmesis: ’sent out’ (ἐξ … ἧκε = ἐξῆκε) · also with ἐν in tmesis: ’sent in, let loose among’ (ἐν … κυδοιμὸν ἧκε ’sent uproar among’) · also with ἐπί in tmesis: ’set on, put on’ (ἐπὶ … λόφον ἧκε ’set a crest on it’)
ἰδομενῆος: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, Cretan leader; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἱερὴν: ἱερός — sacred, holy; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ήν (= Attic ἱεράν)
ἱππῆες: ἱππεύς — horseman, charioteer; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες (= Attic -εῖς)
ἴδης: Ἴδη — Mount Ida; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic Ἴδης)
ἴσαν: εἶμι — go, come; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’went’ · also οἶδα — know; plpf. 3 pl., epic ἴσαν (= Attic ᾔδεσαν): ’knew’
ἴφια: ἴφιος — stout, sturdy (the traditional gloss; ’fat’ also given); neut. acc. pl., with μῆλα
ἵκανον: ἱκάνω — come, arrive at; impf. 3 pl. act., epic (Attic ἀφικνέομαι): ’they came to’
ἵμερον: ἵμερος — longing, desire, yearning; masc. acc. sg.
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj. · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἵνα τ’ ἄνδρες … τελέθουσι ’where men become’) · also + opt., in a purpose clause after a past verb: ’so that … might’ (ἵνα μή … ἵκοιτο ’so that … might not come’)
ὀλοφυδνὸν: ὀλοφυδνός — lamenting, mournful; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἔπος: ’a word of lament’
ὀνόμηνεν: ὀνομαίνω — name, call by name; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, ν-movable (Attic ὀνομάζω): ’named’
ὀρώρει: ὄρνυμι — rouse; perf. ὄρωρα intrans. arise; pluperf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’had arisen’
ὀχθήσας: ὀχθέω — be vexed, be troubled; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’vexed, troubled’
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὄπιθεν: ὄπιθεν — behind, from behind; adv., with the directional suffix -θεν
ὄτρυνε: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ὤτρυνε): ’urged on’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’urge on!’
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὄχεσφιν: ὄχος — chariot, car (usually pl. ὄχεα); neut. dat./gen. pl., old case-suffix -φιν (= Attic ὄχοις, ὀχέων) · also with παρά, locatival: ’beside the chariot’ (πὰρ … ὄχεσφιν)
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅπλεσθαι: ὅπλομαι (ὁπλίζω) — make ready for oneself, prepare; pres. inf. mid.
ὅσσον: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much/great as; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’how much, how far’ · also correlative with τόσσον: ’as much as’ (τόσσον … ὅσσον)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ’beneath him’) · also ὑπ’ ἐκ + gen., ’out from under’ (ὑπ’ ἐκ κακοῦ ’out from under evil’) · also + gen. of the cause, ’before, at the onslaught of’ (ὑπ’ Ἀχιλλῆος ’before Achilles’)
ὑπέστην: ὑφίστημι — place under; mid. and intrans. aor. undertake, promise; aor. 1 sg. (aor. 2 of ὑφίστημι): ’I undertook’
ὑφ: ὑπό (elided ὑφ’, before a rough breathing) — under; + gen. of agent: ’by, at the hands of’ · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑφ’ ἡμετέρῃσιν ’under our (hands)’) · also + gen. of cause: ’from’ (ὑφ’ ὁρμῆς ’from the onrush’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ποσσὶν ὑφ’ ἵππων ’beneath the horses’ feet’)
ὕλην: ὕλη — wood, timber, brushwood; fem. acc. sg. · also Ὕλη — Hyle, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile · also introducing a wish with the optative alone: ’would that’ (ὡς ἔρις … ἀπόλοιτο ’would that strife perish’)
ὢ: ὤ — oh! ah! (exclamation, as in ὢ πόποι)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὦρσε: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse; aor. 3 sg. act., transitive: ’roused’
ᾤμωξέν: οἰμώζω — wail, cry out in distress; aor. 3 sg., augmented ᾤ- (οἰ- → ᾠ-), movable ν: ’wailed’
ᾤχετο: οἴχομαι — be gone, go, have gone; impf. 3 sg., augmented (οἰ- → ᾠ-): ’had gone’ · also of continuous motion, ’went about, kept going’ (κατὰ πτόλιν ᾤχετο πάντῃ ’she went everywhere throughout the city’)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥέξειν: ῥέζω — do, perform, sacrifice; fut. inf. act., in a vow after εὔχεο or εὔχετο: ’(vow) to sacrifice’ · also fut. inf. act., after ἔολπα: ’(I expect you) will do’
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥοδοδάκτυλος: ῥοδοδάκτυλος — rose-fingered; fem. nom. sg., two-ending adj., epithet of Dawn
ῥωπήϊα: ῥωπήϊον — thicket, brushwood; neut. acc. pl.
